## Early life
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Katt_Williams&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Early life")]
Micah Williams was born in [Cincinnati, Ohio](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cincinnati "Cincinnati"), on September 2, 1971.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-1)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-6abc.com-2)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-officialbio-3) He was raised in [Dayton, Ohio](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dayton,_Ohio "Dayton, Ohio") by.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-clubshayshay-4)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-officialbio-3) He stated that he learned to read at three years old, and was communicating in multiple languages, including French and [Haitian Creole](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Haitian_Creole "Haitian Creole"). During his childhood, he lived in [Haiti](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Haiti "Haiti") for a year and a half on religious mission trips with his family.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-5)
Williams [emancipated](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emancipation_of_minors "Emancipation of minors") himself from his parents at age 13 and moved to Florida. Though homeless and living in a park, he supported himself as a street vendor.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-6)[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-:0-7) He stated that he wanted to remain God's friend.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-clubshayshay-4)
Since at least 2016, Williams has stated on numerous occasions that he enlisted in the [United States Marine Corps](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Marine_Corps "United States Marine Corps") as a minor at the age of 16, attended boot camp, and was subsequently discharged when his age was discovered. However, in a CBS News investigation, the Marine Corps stated that there was no record of Williams having ever served in the military or attended any Marine training facilities.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katt_Williams#cite_note-8)

## Terminals
### Main terminal
Check-in, ticketing, baggage claim, the Ground Transport East and West areas, and the single security checkpoint. The rental car and ground transportation center is next to the terminal.
### Concourse A
Holds gates A1 to A23 and most domestic carriers. The Club CVG lounge is between gates A8 and A10, and Urban Crave and Graeter's are nearby.
### Concourse B
The Delta Sky Club is near gate B14 and the Escape Lounge is near gate B12. International arrivals are processed here, and Global Entry kiosks are on the arrivals level.
### Moving between terminals
Concourses A and B are reached from the main terminal by an underground moving walkway and people mover. Both concourses are behind the same security checkpoint, so changing concourses after security does not need a new screening.
[Terminal guide →](https://discoverairports.com/airports/united-states/kentucky/cincinnati-covington-cvg/terminals/)
## Getting to and from CVG
  * Bus
### TANK 2X Airporter
Direct bus to downtown Cincinnati, about 25 minutes. The fare is $1.50 one way, and buses run about every 30 minutes from about 5 a.m. to 12:30 a.m. Board at the baggage claim level by following signs for Ground Transport East. In downtown Cincinnati, the stop is at 5th and Elm.
  * Rideshare and taxi
### Rideshare and taxis
The downtown trip takes 15 to 20 minutes in light traffic. Pickup is at the Ground Transport East and West areas, and traffic can build up near the Brent Spence Bridge at rush hour.
  * Shuttle
### Hotel courtesy shuttles
Hotels in the area run their own shuttles from the Ground Transport areas. Service after midnight may be limited, so arrange ahead of time.
  * Rail
### No rail service
CVG has no rail connection. The Cincinnati Bell Connector streetcar only serves downtown Cincinnati.


[All ground transportation →](https://discoverairports.com/airports/united-states/kentucky/cincinnati-covington-cvg/ground-transportation/)
## Tips for CVG
  * Because CVG is smaller than many hubs, a short connection in Concourse A or B is usually easy, as long as you check gate changes on the screens.
  * Parking is relatively inexpensive. For short trips, the terminal garage is convenient, but for stays of several days the Economy Lot is cheaper.
  * Breeze Airways and other new routes have added service at CVG in 2026. Confirm your gate on the airport screens before walkin
